decisions.reason: Identifies node.exe PID 42432 as the dsh web host holding koffi.node, locked until that process exits so npm cannot overwrite it (EBUSY at copyfile).
Explains refresh only reloads the SPA without stopping the host; gives ordered stop/confirm-exit, pinned install, restart/verify steps without killing unrelated Node processes.
Explains bare spec resolves via latest (0.1.1-rc.2) while alpha is 0.1.2-alpha.5, silently downgrading the installed alpha line; states npm does not preserve the current prerelease.
Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 together with the TUI plugin after stopping DSH; verifies dsh --version is alpha.5 and restarts dsh web.
Tells README authors to pin the exact host version whenever install examples include dsh and to state that a bare name follows latest, avoiding silent downgrade of a prerelease.
